newsitem.title: ITALY: H1 pre-tax profit at Italy's Enel edges higher.
newsitem.headline: H1 pre-tax profit at Italy's Enel edges higher.

text.p: Italian electricity giant Enel, slated for privatisation in 1997, said on Monday its pre-tax profit rose by just under two percent in the first six months of the year to 2.99 trillion lire ($1.97 billion).
The company said in a statement after a board meeting that it expected its full-year result would be roughly in line with its 1995 performance when it recorded a net profit of 1.15 trillion lire.
Enel, one of the largest electricity firms in Europe, said its operating result in the first six months of 1996 totalled 4.54 trillion lire against a previous 4.45 trillion.

The firm provided no net profit or turnover figures for the first half but said it had cut its debt level by 2.52 trillion during this period. At the end of December, Enel's debt totalled 35.1 trillion lire.
The statement said it expected a further dip in debt by the end of the year, although not of the same magnitude as the fall achieved in the first six months.
Electricity sales rose by 1.6 percent in the first half while personnel costs fell by 1.4 percent over the same period, the brief statement said.

Enel, which enjoys a virtual monopoly over electricity distribution and production in Italy, said it expected to fully cover a fall in revenues in the second half caused by a cut in tariffs introduced in July.
Chicco Testa, recently appointed chairman of the Italian state company, said earlier this month that the firm was ready for privatisation and was only awaiting a government go-ahead.
"We are ready, the prospectus is ready, now it is up to the government to create the authority and then the Treasury," Testa told reporters.
Legislation covering the creation of a watchdog authority to oversee the electricity and gas sectors has been held up in parliament for months.
The long-awaited ratification could come on Tuesday when the Senate (upper house) industry committee meets to approve the members of the watchdog committee.
If approval is granted, the way would be open for a first tranche flotation for Enel in the Spring of next year. $1 = 1,523 lire
